h: Canada-based Pastor Tayo reportedly deletes posts about Tope Alabi after a legal ultimatum
p: Pastor Tayo has reportedly removed Facebook posts that linked gospel singer Tope Alabi to the death of singer Toluwanisings. Alabi's lawyers had sent a letter on 24 October demanding removal within 24 hours, a retraction and an apology, saying no investigation had linked her to the death. The posts are gone, but no apology has been reported.
more: The lawyers said the claims were baseless.
Woli Agba and Dele Omo Woli have also reportedly taken legal steps over similar claims.
